def smart_text(s: str) -> str:
    s = s.replace('...', '…')
    s = s.replace('---', '—').replace('--', '–')
    out=[]; openq=True
    for ch in s:
        if ch == '"':
            out.append('“' if openq else '”'); openq = not openq
        else: out.append(ch)
    return ''.join(out)

SUBDIG = str.maketrans('0123456789+-=()', '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉₊₋₌₍₎')
SUPDIG = str.maketrans('0123456789+-=()', '⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹⁺⁻⁼⁽⁾')

def tex_escape(s: str) -> str:
    repl = {'\\':r'\textbackslash{}','&':r'\&','%':r'\%','$':r'\$','#':r'\#','_':r'\_','{':r'\{','}':r'\}','~':r'\textasciitilde{}','^':r'\textasciicircum{}'}
    return ''.join(repl.get(c,c) for c in s)

def md_escape(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace('\\','\\\\')

# ---------- inline parsing/rendering ----------
def find_closing(s, start, delim):
    j = s.find(delim, start)
    while j != -1 and j > 0 and s[j-1] == '\\':
        j = s.find(delim, j+len(delim))
    return j

def parse_bracket(s, i, opench='[', closech=']'):
    if i >= len(s) or s[i] != opench: return None
    depth=1; j=i+1
    while j < len(s):
        if s[j] == '\\': j += 2; continue
        if s[j] == opench: depth += 1
        elif s[j] == closech:
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0: return s[i+1:j], j+1
        j += 1
    return None

def parse_paren(s, i):
    if i >= len(s) or s[i] != '(': return None
    depth=1; j=i+1; quote=None
    while j < len(s):
        c=s[j]
        if c == '\\': j+=2; continue
        if quote:
            if c == quote: quote=None
        else:
            if c in '"\'': quote=c
            elif c == '(': depth+=1
            elif c == ')':
                depth-=1
                if depth==0: return s[i+1:j], j+1
        j+=1
    return None

def split_target_title(content: str):
    content = content.strip()
    m = re.match(r'([^\s]+)\s+["\'](.*)["\']\s*$', content)
    if m: return m.group(1), m.group(2)
    return content, ''

def render_text_segment(seg: str, fmt: str) -> str:
    seg = seg.replace('\\\n', '\u0000').replace('  \n', '\u0000').replace('\n', ' ')
    parts = seg.split('\u0000')
    out=[]
    for idx,p in enumerate(parts):
        p = p.replace('\\*','*').replace('\\_','_').replace('\\[','[').replace('\\]',']').replace('\\`','`').replace('\\#','#').replace('\\<','<').replace('\\>','>')
        if fmt in ('html','plain','ansi'):
            p = smart_text(p)
        if fmt == 'html': p = html.escape(p, quote=False)
        elif fmt == 'latex': p = tex_escape(p)
        out.append(p)
        if idx != len(parts)-1:
            out.append({'html':'<br />\n','latex':'\\\\\n','plain':'\n','markdown':'\\\n'}.get(fmt,'\n'))
    return ''.join(out)

def render_inlines(s: str, fmt: str) -> str:
    res=[]; i=0
    n=len(s)
    while i<n:
        # code spans
        if s[i] == '`':
            m = re.match(r'`+', s[i:]); delim=m.group(0); j=s.find(delim, i+len(delim))
            if j!=-1:
                code=s[i+len(delim):j].strip() if '\n' not in s[i+len(delim):j] else s[i+len(delim):j].replace('\n',' ')
                if fmt=='html': res.append('<code>'+html.escape(code)+'</code>')
                elif fmt=='latex': res.append(r'\texttt{'+tex_escape(code)+'}')
                elif fmt=='plain': res.append(code)
                else: res.append('`'+code+'`')
                i=j+len(delim); continue
        # display math then inline math
        if s.startswith('$$', i):
            j=find_closing(s, i+2, '$$')
            if j!=-1:
                mathc=s[i+2:j]
                if fmt=='html': res.append('<span class="math display">'+render_math_html(mathc)+'</span>')
                elif fmt=='latex': res.append('\\['+mathc+'\\]')
                elif fmt=='plain': res.append('\n'+math_to_plain(mathc)+'\n')
                else: res.append('$$'+mathc+'$$')
                i=j+2; continue
        if s[i] == '$' and (i+1<n and s[i+1] != '$'):
            j=find_closing(s, i+1, '$')
            if j!=-1:
                mathc=s[i+1:j]
                if fmt=='html': res.append('<span class="math inline">'+render_math_html(mathc)+'</span>')
                elif fmt=='latex': res.append('\\('+mathc+'\\)')
                elif fmt=='plain': res.append(math_to_plain(mathc))
                else: res.append('$'+mathc+'$')
                i=j+1; continue
        # images
        if s.startswith('![', i):
            br=parse_bracket(s, i+1)
            if br and br[1] < n and s[br[1]] == '(':
                par=parse_paren(s, br[1])
                if par:
                    alt=br[0]; target,title=split_target_title(par[0])
                    alt_html=render_inlines(alt,'plain')
                    if fmt=='html':
                        attrs=f'src="{html.escape(target, quote=True)}"'
                        if title: attrs += f' title="{html.escape(title, quote=True)}"'
                        attrs += f' alt="{html.escape(alt_html, quote=True)}"'
                        res.append(f'<img {attrs} />')
                    elif fmt=='latex': res.append(r'\pandocbounded{\includegraphics[keepaspectratio,alt={'+tex_escape(alt_html)+'}]{'+tex_escape(target)+'}}')
                    elif fmt=='plain': res.append('['+alt_html+']')
                    else: res.append(f'![{alt}]({target}' + (f' "{title}"' if title else '') + ')')
                    i=par[1]; continue
        # links or spans
        if s[i] == '[':
            br=parse_bracket(s, i)
            if br:
                k=br[1]
                if k<n and s[k]=='(':
                    par=parse_paren(s,k)
                    if par:
                        target,title=split_target_title(par[0]); label=br[0]
                        if fmt=='html':
                            attrs=f'href="{html.escape(target, quote=True)}"'
                            if title: attrs += f' title="{html.escape(title, quote=True)}"'
                            res.append(f'<a {attrs}>{render_inlines(label, fmt)}</a>')
                        elif fmt=='latex':
                            lab=render_inlines(label, fmt)
                            if target.startswith('mailto:'): res.append(r'\href{'+tex_escape(target)+'}{'+lab+'}')
                            else: res.append(r'\href{'+tex_escape(target)+'}{'+lab+'}')
                        elif fmt=='plain': res.append(render_inlines(label, fmt))
                        else: res.append(f'[{label}]({target}' + (f' "{title}"' if title else '') + ')')
                        i=par[1]; continue
                if k<n and s[k]=='{':
                    j=s.find('}', k+1)
                    if j!=-1:
                        label=br[0]; attr=s[k+1:j].strip(); cls=''
                        cm=re.search(r'\.([\w-]+)', attr)
                        if cm: cls=cm.group(1)
                        if fmt=='html': res.append(f'<span class="{html.escape(cls,quote=True)}">{render_inlines(label, fmt)}</span>' if cls else render_inlines(label, fmt))
                        elif fmt=='plain': res.append(render_inlines(label, fmt))
                        elif fmt=='latex': res.append('{'+render_inlines(label,fmt)+'}')
                        else: res.append(s[i:j+1])
                        i=j+1; continue
        # autolinks
        if s[i] == '<':
            j=s.find('>', i+1)
            if j!=-1:
                cont=s[i+1:j]
                if re.match(r'https?://|ftp://', cont):
                    if fmt=='html': res.append(f'<a href="{html.escape(cont,quote=True)}" class="uri">{html.escape(cont)}</a>')
                    elif fmt=='latex': res.append(r'\url{'+tex_escape(cont)+'}')
                    elif fmt=='plain': res.append(cont)
                    else: res.append('<'+cont+'>')
                    i=j+1; continue
                if re.match(r'[^@\s<>]+@[^@\s<>]+\.[^@\s<>]+$', cont):
                    if fmt=='html': res.append(f'<a href="mailto:{html.escape(cont,quote=True)}" class="email">{html.escape(cont)}</a>')
                    elif fmt=='latex': res.append(r'\href{mailto:'+tex_escape(cont)+'}{\nolinkurl{'+tex_escape(cont)+'}}')
                    elif fmt=='plain': res.append(cont)
                    else: res.append('<'+cont+'>')
                    i=j+1; continue
                # raw html tag
                if re.match(r'/?[A-Za-z][^>]*$', cont):
                    if fmt=='html': res.append('<'+cont+'>')
                    elif fmt=='plain': pass
                    elif fmt=='latex': pass
                    else: res.append('<'+cont+'>')
                    i=j+1; continue
        # formatting delimiters
        matched=False
        for delim, tag, ltx in [('**','strong','textbf'),('__','strong','textbf'),('~~','del','st')]:
            if s.startswith(delim,i):
                j=find_closing(s, i+len(delim), delim)
                if j!=-1:
                    inner=s[i+len(delim):j]
                    if fmt=='html': res.append(f'<{tag}>'+render_inlines(inner,fmt)+f'</{tag}>')
                    elif fmt=='latex': res.append('\\'+ltx+'{'+render_inlines(inner,fmt)+'}')
                    elif fmt=='plain': res.append(render_inlines(inner,fmt))
                    else: res.append(delim+render_inlines(inner,fmt)+delim)
                    i=j+len(delim); matched=True; break
        if matched: continue
        if s[i] in '*_' and not (i+1<n and s[i+1]==s[i]):
            delim=s[i]; j=find_closing(s, i+1, delim)
            if j!=-1 and j>i+1:
                inner=s[i+1:j]
                if fmt=='html': res.append('<em>'+render_inlines(inner,fmt)+'</em>')
                elif fmt=='latex': res.append(r'\emph{'+render_inlines(inner,fmt)+'}')
                elif fmt=='plain': res.append(render_inlines(inner,fmt))
                else: res.append(delim+render_inlines(inner,fmt)+delim)
                i=j+1; continue
        if s[i] == '~' and not s.startswith('~~',i):
            j=find_closing(s,i+1,'~')
            if j!=-1:
                inner=s[i+1:j]
                if fmt=='html': res.append('<sub>'+render_inlines(inner,fmt)+'</sub>')
                elif fmt=='latex': res.append(r'\textsubscript{'+render_inlines(inner,fmt)+'}')
                elif fmt=='plain': res.append(render_inlines(inner,fmt).translate(SUBDIG))
                else: res.append('~'+render_inlines(inner,fmt)+'~')
                i=j+1; continue
        if s[i] == '^':
            j=find_closing(s,i+1,'^')
            if j!=-1:
                inner=s[i+1:j]
                if fmt=='html': res.append('<sup>'+render_inlines(inner,fmt)+'</sup>')
                elif fmt=='latex': res.append(r'\textsuperscript{'+render_inlines(inner,fmt)+'}')
                elif fmt=='plain': res.append(render_inlines(inner,fmt).translate(SUPDIG))
                else: res.append('^'+render_inlines(inner,fmt)+'^')
                i=j+1; continue
        # accumulate ordinary text
        j=i+1
        specials='`$![<*_~^'
        while j<n and s[j] not in specials:
            j+=1
        res.append(render_text_segment(s[i:j], fmt))
        i=j
    return ''.join(res)

def render_math_html(m: str) -> str:
    # A tiny TeX-ish presentation for common examples.
    m = html.escape(m)
    m = re.sub(r'([A-Za-z])', r'<em>\1</em>', m)
    m = re.sub(r'\^\{?([^}\s]+)\}?', lambda x: '<sup>'+x.group(1)+'</sup>', m)
    m = m.replace('=', ' = ').replace('+', ' + ')
    return m

def math_to_plain(m: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r'\^\{?([0-9+-=()]+)\}?', lambda x: x.group(1).translate(SUPDIG), m)

def parse_markdown(text: str):
    text = text.replace('\r\n','\n').replace('\r','\n')
    lines = text.split('\n')
    meta={}; blocks=[]; i=0
    # YAML metadata
    if lines and lines[0].strip() == '---':
        j=1; y=[]
        while j < len(lines) and lines[j].strip() not in ('---','...'):
            y.append(lines[j]); j+=1
        if j < len(lines):
            i=j+1; cur=None
            for line in y:
                m=re.match(r'([A-Za-z0-9_-]+):\s*(.*)$', line)
                if m:
                    cur=m.group(1); val=m.group(2).strip().strip('"\'')
                    if val == '': meta[cur]=[]
                    else: meta[cur]=val
                elif cur and line.strip().startswith('-'):
                    if not isinstance(meta.get(cur), list): meta[cur]=[]
                    meta[cur].append(line.strip()[1:].strip().strip('"\''))
    # pandoc title block
    if i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith('%'):
        keys=['title','author','date']; k=0
        while i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith('%') and k < len(keys):
            meta[keys[k]] = lines[i][1:].strip(); i+=1; k+=1
        while i < len(lines) and not lines[i].strip(): i+=1
    def is_block_start(idx):
        if idx>=len(lines): return True
        l=lines[idx]
        return (not l.strip() or re.match(r' {0,3}#{1,6}\s+',l) or re.match(r' {0,3}(```|~~~)',l) or re.match(r' {0,3}([-*_])\s*(\1\s*){2,}$',l.strip()) or re.match(r' {0,3}>',l) or re.match(r' {0,3}([-+*])\s+',l) or re.match(r' {0,3}\d+[.)]\s+',l) or (idx+1<len(lines) and re.match(r' {0,3}[-:| ]+\|[-:| ]+$', lines[idx+1] if '|' in lines[idx] else '')))
    while i < len(lines):
        line=lines[i]
        if not line.strip(): i+=1; continue
        # fenced code
        m=re.match(r' {0,3}(```+|~~~+)\s*(.*)$', line)
        if m:
            fence=m.group(1); info=m.group(2).strip(); i+=1; code=[]
            while i<len(lines) and not re.match(r' {0,3}'+re.escape(fence[0])*len(fence)+r'\s*$', lines[i]):
                code.append(lines[i]); i+=1
            if i<len(lines): i+=1
            ident=''; classes=[]; attrs=[]
            if info:
                if info.startswith('{') and info.endswith('}'):
                    for tok in info[1:-1].split():
                        if tok.startswith('.'): classes.append(tok[1:])
                        elif tok.startswith('#'): ident=tok[1:]
                        elif '=' in tok: attrs.append(tuple(tok.split('=',1)))
                else: classes.append(info.split()[0])
            blocks.append(B('CodeBlock', text='\n'.join(code), id=ident, classes=classes, attrs=attrs)); continue
        # atx header
        m=re.match(r' {0,3}(#{1,6})\s+(.*?)(?:\s+#+\s*)?$', line)
        if m:
            level=len(m.group(1)); content=m.group(2).strip(); ident=''; classes=[]
            am=re.search(r'\s*\{([^}]*)\}\s*$', content)
            if am:
                content=content[:am.start()].rstrip()
                for tok in am.group(1).split():
                    if tok.startswith('#'): ident=tok[1:]
                    elif tok.startswith('.'): classes.append(tok[1:])
            blocks.append(B('Header', level=level, text=content, id=ident or slugify(render_inlines(content,'plain')), classes=classes)); i+=1; continue
        # setext header
        if i+1<len(lines) and re.match(r' {0,3}(=+|-+)\s*$', lines[i+1]) and line.strip():
            level=1 if lines[i+1].lstrip().startswith('=') else 2
            blocks.append(B('Header', level=level, text=line.strip(), id=slugify(render_inlines(line.strip(),'plain')), classes=[])); i+=2; continue
        # horizontal rule
        if re.match(r' {0,3}([-*_])\s*(\1\s*){2,}$', line.strip()):
            blocks.append(B('HorizontalRule')); i+=1; continue
        # blockquote
        if re.match(r' {0,3}>', line):
            q=[]
            while i<len(lines) and (re.match(r' {0,3}> ?', lines[i]) or not lines[i].strip()):
                if re.match(r' {0,3}> ?', lines[i]): q.append(re.sub(r' {0,3}> ?', '', lines[i], count=1))
                else: q.append('')
                i+=1
            qm,qb=parse_markdown('\n'.join(q)); blocks.append(B('BlockQuote', blocks=qb)); continue
        # raw html block or comments
        if re.match(r'\s*<!--', line) or re.match(r'\s*</?(div|section|article|header|footer|table|script|style|p|h[1-6]|ul|ol|li|blockquote|pre)\b', line, re.I):
            raw=[]
            while i<len(lines) and lines[i].strip(): raw.append(lines[i]); i+=1
            # For inline-like single span let it be paragraph; for block tags raw block.
            rawtxt='\n'.join(raw)
            if re.match(r'\s*<(p|h[1-6]|ul|ol|blockquote|pre|table)\b', rawtxt, re.I):
                _, hb = parse_html(rawtxt); blocks.extend(hb)
            else: blocks.append(B('RawBlock', format='html', text=rawtxt))
            continue
        # pipe table
        if '|' in line and i+1<len(lines) and '|' in lines[i+1] and re.match(r'^[\s|:-]+$', lines[i+1]):
            headers=split_pipe_row(line); sep=split_pipe_row(lines[i+1]); aligns=[]
            for c in sep:
                c=c.strip(); aligns.append('right' if c.startswith('-') and c.endswith(':') else 'center' if c.startswith(':') and c.endswith(':') else 'left' if c.startswith(':') else 'default')
            i+=2; rows=[]
            while i<len(lines) and '|' in lines[i] and lines[i].strip(): rows.append(split_pipe_row(lines[i])); i+=1
            blocks.append(B('Table', headers=headers, aligns=aligns, rows=rows)); continue
        # lists
        m=re.match(r' {0,3}([-+*])\s+(.+)$', line)
        om=re.match(r' {0,3}(\d+)[.)]\s+(.+)$', line)
        if m or om:
            ordered=bool(om); start=int(om.group(1)) if om else 1; items=[]
            pat = r' {0,3}\d+[.)]\s+(.+)$' if ordered else r' {0,3}[-+*]\s+(.+)$'
            while i<len(lines):
                mm=re.match(pat, lines[i])
                if not mm: break
                item=[mm.group(1)]; i+=1
                while i<len(lines) and lines[i].startswith(('  ','    ')) and not re.match(pat, lines[i]):
                    item.append(re.sub(r'^ {2,4}', '', lines[i])); i+=1
                _, ib=parse_markdown('\n'.join(item))
                items.append(ib or [B('Para', text='')])
                while i<len(lines) and not lines[i].strip():
                    # blank ends tight list unless next item follows; keep one blank in item? pandoc tight if no blank
                    if i+1<len(lines) and re.match(pat, lines[i+1]): i+=1; break
                    else: break
            blocks.append(B('OrderedList' if ordered else 'BulletList', items=items, start=start)); continue
        # indented code
        if line.startswith('    '):
            code=[]
            while i<len(lines) and (lines[i].startswith('    ') or not lines[i].strip()):
                code.append(lines[i][4:] if lines[i].startswith('    ') else '') ; i+=1
            while code and code[-1]=='': code.pop()
            blocks.append(B('CodeBlock', text='\n'.join(code), id='', classes=[], attrs=[])); continue
        # paragraph
        para=[line]; i+=1
        while i<len(lines) and not is_block_start(i): para.append(lines[i]); i+=1
        ptxt='\n'.join(para).strip()
        im=image_only(ptxt)
        if im: blocks.append(B('Figure', alt=im[0], src=im[1], title=im[2]))
        else: blocks.append(B('Para', text=ptxt))
    return meta, blocks

def image_only(s):
    m=re.match(r'^!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^\s)]+)(?:\s+["\']([^"\']*)["\'])?\)\s*$', s.strip(), re.S)
    return (m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3) or '') if m else None

def split_pipe_row(line):
    line=line.strip()
    if line.startswith('|'): line=line[1:]
    if line.endswith('|'): line=line[:-1]
    return [c.strip() for c in re.split(r'(?<!\\)\|', line)]

class SimpleHTMLToMarkdown(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self): super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True); self.out=[]; self.stack=[]; self.href=[]; self.in_head=False
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs=dict(attrs); t=tag.lower()
        if t in ('head','script','style'): self.in_head=True; return
        if self.in_head: return
        if re.fullmatch(r'h[1-6]', t): self.out.append('\n' + '#' * int(t[1]) + ' ')
        elif t=='p': self.out.append('\n')
        elif t=='br': self.out.append('  \n')
        elif t in ('em','i'): self.out.append('*')
        elif t in ('strong','b'): self.out.append('**')
        elif t=='code': self.out.append('`')
        elif t=='pre': self.out.append('\n```\n')
        elif t=='a': self.out.append('['); self.href.append(attrs.get('href',''))
        elif t=='img': self.out.append('!['+attrs.get('alt','')+']('+attrs.get('src','')+')')
        elif t=='li': self.out.append('\n- ')
        elif t=='blockquote': self.out.append('\n> ')
        elif t=='tr': self.out.append('\n')
        elif t in ('td','th'): pass
        self.stack.append(t)
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        t=tag.lower()
        if t in ('head','script','style'): self.in_head=False; return
        if self.in_head: return
        if t in ('em','i'): self.out.append('*')
        elif t in ('strong','b'): self.out.append('**')
        elif t=='code': self.out.append('`')
        elif t=='pre': self.out.append('\n```\n')
        elif t=='a': self.out.append(']('+(self.href.pop() if self.href else '')+')')
        elif re.fullmatch(r'h[1-6]', t) or t=='p': self.out.append('\n\n')
        elif t=='blockquote': self.out.append('\n')
        if self.stack: 
            try: self.stack.remove(t)
            except ValueError: pass
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if not self.in_head: self.out.append(data)

def parse_html(text: str):
    p=SimpleHTMLToMarkdown(); p.feed(text)
    md=''.join(p.out)
    md=re.sub(r'\n{3,}', '\n\n', md).strip('\n')+'\n'
    return parse_markdown(md)

def parse_csv_text(text: str, delim=','):
    rows=list(csv.reader(StringIO(text), delimiter=delim))
    if not rows: return {}, []
    headers=rows[0]; body=rows[1:]
    return {}, [B('Table', headers=headers, aligns=['default']*len(headers), rows=body)]

def parse_json_doc(text: str):
    try: obj=json.loads(text)
    except Exception: return {}, [B('Para', text=text.strip())] if text.strip() else []
    meta=obj.get('meta',{}) if isinstance(obj,dict) else {}; blocks=[]
    # minimal pandoc json reader
    for b in obj.get('blocks',[]) if isinstance(obj,dict) else []:
        if b.get('t')=='Para': blocks.append(B('Para', text=inlines_json_to_md(b.get('c',[]))))
        elif b.get('t')=='Header': blocks.append(B('Header', level=b['c'][0], id=b['c'][1][0], classes=b['c'][1][1], text=inlines_json_to_md(b['c'][2])))
    return meta, blocks

def inlines_json_to_md(arr):
    out=[]
    for x in arr:
        t=x.get('t'); c=x.get('c')
        if t=='Str': out.append(c)
        elif t=='Space': out.append(' ')
        elif t=='SoftBreak': out.append('\n')
        elif t=='Emph': out.append('*'+inlines_json_to_md(c)+'*')
        elif t=='Strong': out.append('**'+inlines_json_to_md(c)+'**')
        elif t=='Code': out.append('`'+c[1]+'`')
    return ''.join(out)

# ---------- writers ----------
def write_blocks(blocks, fmt: str, meta=None, opts=None) -> str:
    meta=meta or {}; opts=opts or {}
    if fmt in ('html','html5','html4','chunkedhtml','revealjs','s5','slidy','slideous','dzslides'):
        body=write_html(blocks, opts)
        if opts.get('standalone'):
            title = get_title(meta, opts)
            header=''
            if meta.get('title'):
                header='<header id="title-block-header">\n<h1 class="title">'+render_inlines(str(meta.get('title')),'html')+'</h1>\n</header>\n'
            toc = make_toc(blocks) if opts.get('toc') else ''
            return HTML_TEMPLATE.format(title=html.escape(title), header=header, toc=toc, body=body)
        return body
    if fmt in ('plain','ansi'): return write_plain(blocks)
    if fmt in ('markdown','commonmark','commonmark_x','gfm','markdown_github','markdown_strict','markdown_mmd','markdown_phpextra'): return write_markdown(blocks)
    if fmt in ('latex','beamer','context'): return write_latex(blocks, meta, opts)
    if fmt=='json': return write_json(blocks, meta)
    if fmt=='native': return write_native(blocks)
    if fmt=='rst': return write_rst(blocks)
    if fmt=='man': return write_man(blocks)
    if fmt in ('docbook','docbook4','docbook5','xml','opendocument','tei'): return write_xmlish(blocks)
    if fmt in ('csv','tsv'): return write_csv(blocks, '\t' if fmt=='tsv' else ',')
    # unsupported rich formats: produce markdown/plain textual content rather than failing
    return write_markdown(blocks) if fmt in OUTPUT_FORMATS else write_html(blocks, opts)

def get_title(meta, opts):
    if 'title' in meta: return str(meta['title'])
    files=opts.get('files') or []
    if files: return os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(files[0]))[0]
    return ''

def make_toc(blocks):
    heads=[b for b in blocks if b['t']=='Header']
    if not heads: return ''
    out=['<nav id="TOC" role="doc-toc">','<ul>']
    for h in heads: out.append(f'<li><a href="#{h["id"]}">{render_inlines(h["text"],"html")}</a></li>')
    out += ['</ul>','</nav>']
    return '\n'.join(out)+'\n'

def write_html(blocks, opts=None):
    out=[]
    for b in blocks:
        t=b['t']
        if t=='Header': out.append(f'<h{b["level"]} id="{html.escape(b.get("id") or slugify(render_inlines(b["text"],"plain")), quote=True)}">{render_inlines(b["text"],"html")}</h{b["level"]}>')
        elif t=='Para': out.append('<p>'+render_inlines(b['text'],'html')+'</p>')
        elif t=='Plain': out.append(render_inlines(b['text'],'html'))
        elif t=='CodeBlock':
            cls=''
            if b.get('classes'): cls=' class="'+' '.join('language-'+html.escape(c,quote=True) for c in b['classes'])+'"'
            out.append(f'<pre><code{cls}>'+html.escape(b.get('text',''))+'</code></pre>')
        elif t=='HorizontalRule': out.append('<hr />')
        elif t=='BlockQuote': out.append('<blockquote>\n'+write_html(b['blocks']).rstrip('\n')+'\n</blockquote>')
        elif t=='BulletList':
            out.append('<ul>')
            for item in b['items']: out.append('<li>'+write_item_html(item)+'</li>')
            out.append('</ul>')
        elif t=='OrderedList':
            attr='' if b.get('start',1)==1 else f' start="{b.get("start")}"'
            out.append(f'<ol type="1"{attr}>')
            for item in b['items']: out.append('<li>'+write_item_html(item)+'</li>')
            out.append('</ol>')
        elif t=='Table': out.append(write_table_html(b))
        elif t=='RawBlock': out.append(b.get('text',''))
        elif t=='Figure':
            altplain=render_inlines(b['alt'],'plain')
            attrs=f'src="{html.escape(b["src"],quote=True)}"'
            if b.get('title'): attrs += f' title="{html.escape(b["title"],quote=True)}"'
            attrs += f' alt="{html.escape(altplain,quote=True)}"'
            out.append('<figure>\n<img '+attrs+' />\n<figcaption aria-hidden="true">'+render_inlines(b['alt'],'html')+'</figcaption>\n</figure>')
    return '\n'.join(out)+'\n'

def write_item_html(item):
    if len(item)==1 and item[0]['t']=='Para': return render_inlines(item[0]['text'],'html')
    return '\n'+write_html(item).rstrip('\n')+'\n'

def write_table_html(b):
    aligns=b.get('aligns') or []
    def style(i, head=False):
        al=aligns[i] if i<len(aligns) else 'default'
        return ' style="text-align: right;"' if al=='right' else ' style="text-align: center;"' if al=='center' else ' style="text-align: left;"' if al=='left' and not head else ''
    out=['<table>','<thead>','<tr>']
    for i,h in enumerate(b.get('headers',[])): out.append(f'<th{style(i, True)}>{render_inlines(h,"html")}</th>')
    out += ['</tr>','</thead>','<tbody>']
    for row in b.get('rows',[]):
        out.append('<tr>')
        for i,c in enumerate(row): out.append(f'<td{style(i)}>{render_inlines(c,"html")}</td>')
        out.append('</tr>')
    out += ['</tbody>','</table>']
    return '\n'.join(out)

def write_plain(blocks):
    parts=[]
    for b in blocks:
        t=b['t']
        if t=='Header': parts.append(render_inlines(b['text'],'plain'))
        elif t=='Para': parts.append(render_inlines(b['text'],'plain'))
        elif t=='CodeBlock': parts.append(textwrap.indent(b.get('text',''),'    '))
        elif t=='HorizontalRule': parts.append('-'*72)
        elif t=='BlockQuote': parts.append(textwrap.indent(write_plain(b['blocks']).strip(),'  '))
        elif t=='BulletList':
            parts.append('\n'.join('- '+write_plain(item).strip().replace('\n','\n  ') for item in b['items']))
        elif t=='OrderedList':
            parts.append('\n'.join(f'{i+b.get("start",1)}.  '+write_plain(item).strip().replace('\n','\n    ') for i,item in enumerate(b['items'])))
        elif t=='Table': parts.append(write_table_markdown(b))
        elif t=='RawBlock': parts.append(strip_tags(b.get('text','')))
        elif t=='Figure': parts.append('['+render_inlines(b['alt'],'plain')+']')
    return '\n\n'.join(p for p in parts if p!='')+'\n'

def write_markdown(blocks):
    parts=[]
    for b in blocks:
        t=b['t']
        if t=='Header': parts.append('#'*b['level']+' '+render_inlines(b['text'],'markdown'))
        elif t=='Para': parts.append(render_inlines(b['text'],'markdown'))
        elif t=='CodeBlock':
            if b.get('classes') or b.get('id') or '```' in b.get('text',''):
                info=' '.join(b.get('classes') or [])
                parts.append('```'+info+'\n'+b.get('text','')+'\n```')
            else: parts.append(textwrap.indent(b.get('text',''),'    '))
        elif t=='HorizontalRule': parts.append('-'*72)
        elif t=='BlockQuote': parts.append('\n'.join('> '+ln if ln else '>' for ln in write_markdown(b['blocks']).strip().split('\n')))
        elif t=='BulletList': parts.append('\n'.join('- '+write_markdown(item).strip().replace('\n','\n  ') for item in b['items']))
        elif t=='OrderedList': parts.append('\n'.join(f'{i+b.get("start",1)}.  '+write_markdown(item).strip().replace('\n','\n    ') for i,item in enumerate(b['items'])))
        elif t=='Table': parts.append(write_table_markdown(b))
        elif t=='RawBlock': parts.append(b.get('text',''))
        elif t=='Figure': parts.append(f'![{b["alt"]}]({b["src"]}'+(f' "{b["title"]}"' if b.get('title') else '')+')')
    return '\n\n'.join(parts)+'\n'

def write_table_markdown(b):
    rows=[b.get('headers',[])] + b.get('rows',[])
    n=max((len(r) for r in rows), default=0)
    widths=[3]*n
    for r in rows:
        for i,c in enumerate(r): widths[i]=max(widths[i], len(render_inlines(c,'plain')))
    def fmtrow(r):
        return '  ' + ' '.join((render_inlines(r[i],'markdown') if i<len(r) else '').ljust(widths[i]) for i in range(n)).rstrip() if n else ''
    sep='  '+' '.join('-'*widths[i] for i in range(n)).rstrip()
    out=[fmtrow(b.get('headers',[])), sep]
    out += [fmtrow(r) for r in b.get('rows',[])]
    return '\n'.join(out)

def write_latex(blocks, meta=None, opts=None):
    parts=[]
    for b in blocks:
        t=b['t']
        if t=='Header':
            cmds=['section','subsection','subsubsection','paragraph','subparagraph','subparagraph']; parts.append('\\'+cmds[min(b['level'],6)-1]+'{'+render_inlines(b['text'],'latex')+'}\\label{'+(b.get('id') or slugify(b['text']))+'}')
        elif t=='Para': parts.append(render_inlines(b['text'],'latex'))
        elif t=='CodeBlock': parts.append('\\begin{verbatim}\n'+b.get('text','')+'\n\\end{verbatim}')
        elif t=='HorizontalRule': parts.append(r'\begin{center}\rule{0.5\linewidth}{0.5pt}\end{center}')
        elif t=='BlockQuote': parts.append('\\begin{quote}\n'+write_latex(b['blocks']).strip()+'\n\\end{quote}')
        elif t=='BulletList':
            s=['\\begin{itemize}',r'\tightlist']
            for item in b['items']: s.append('\\item\n  '+write_latex(item).strip().replace('\n','\n  '))
            s.append('\\end{itemize}'); parts.append('\n'.join(s))
        elif t=='OrderedList':
            s=['\\begin{enumerate}',r'\def\labelenumi{\arabic{enumi}.}',r'\tightlist']
            for item in b['items']: s.append('\\item\n  '+write_latex(item).strip().replace('\n','\n  '))
            s.append('\\end{enumerate}'); parts.append('\n'.join(s))
        elif t=='Table': parts.append(write_table_latex(b))
        elif t=='RawBlock': parts.append(strip_tags(b.get('text','')))
        elif t=='Figure':
            parts.append('\\begin{figure}\n\\centering\n\\pandocbounded{\\includegraphics[keepaspectratio,alt={'+tex_escape(render_inlines(b['alt'],'plain'))+'}]{'+tex_escape(b['src'])+'}}\n\\caption{'+render_inlines(b['alt'],'latex')+'}\n\\end{figure}')
    body='\n\n'.join(parts)+'\n'
    if opts and opts.get('standalone'):
        title = meta.get('title','') if meta else ''
        return '\\documentclass{article}\n\\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}\n\\usepackage{hyperref}\n\\begin{document}\n' + (('\\title{'+tex_escape(str(title))+'}\n\\maketitle\n') if title else '') + body + '\\end{document}\n'
    return body

def write_table_latex(b):
    n=len(b.get('headers',[])); spec=''.join('r' if a=='right' else 'c' if a=='center' else 'l' for a in (b.get('aligns') or ['l']*n))
    out=['\\begin{longtable}[]{@{}'+spec+'@{}}', r'\toprule\noalign{}']
    out.append(' & '.join(render_inlines(x,'latex') for x in b.get('headers',[])) + r' \\')
    out += [r'\midrule\noalign{}', r'\endhead', r'\bottomrule\noalign{}', r'\endlastfoot']
    for row in b.get('rows',[]): out.append(' & '.join(render_inlines(x,'latex') for x in row) + r' \\')
    out.append('\\end{longtable}')
    return '\n'.join(out)

def inline_json_from_text(s):
    # Basic tokenization matching Pandoc JSON shape for plain words/spaces and common inline elements.
    plain=render_inlines(s,'plain')
    arr=[]
    parts=re.split(r'(\s+)', plain)
    for p in parts:
        if p=='': continue
        if p.isspace(): arr.append({'t':'Space'})
        else: arr.append({'t':'Str','c':p})
    return arr

def block_json(b):
    t=b['t']
    if t=='Header': return {'t':'Header','c':[b['level'],[b.get('id',''),b.get('classes',[]),[]],inline_json_from_text(b['text'])]}
    if t=='Para': return {'t':'Para','c':inline_json_from_text(b['text'])}
    if t=='CodeBlock': return {'t':'CodeBlock','c':[[b.get('id',''),b.get('classes',[]),b.get('attrs',[])],b.get('text','')]}
    if t=='HorizontalRule': return {'t':'HorizontalRule'}
    if t=='BlockQuote': return {'t':'BlockQuote','c':[block_json(x) for x in b['blocks']]}
    if t=='BulletList': return {'t':'BulletList','c':[[block_json(x) for x in item] for item in b['items']]}
    if t=='OrderedList': return {'t':'OrderedList','c':[[b.get('start',1),{'t':'Decimal'},{'t':'Period'}],[[block_json(x) for x in item] for item in b['items']]]}
    if t=='Table': return {'t':'Table','c':str(b)}

def find_closing(s, start, delim):
    j = s.find(delim, start)
    while j != -1 and j > 0 and s[j-1] == '\\':
        j = s.find(delim, j+len(delim))
    return j

def parse_bracket(s, i, opench='[', closech=']'):
    if i >= len(s) or s[i] != opench: return None
    depth=1; j=i+1
    while j < len(s):
        if s[j] == '\\': j += 2; continue
        if s[j] == opench: depth += 1
        elif s[j] == closech:
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0: return s[i+1:j], j+1
        j += 1
    return None

def parse_paren(s, i):
    if i >= len(s) or s[i] != '(': return None
    depth=1; j=i+1; quote=None
    while j < len(s):
        c=s[j]
        if c == '\\': j+=2; continue
        if quote:
            if c == quote: quote=None
        else:
            if c in '"\'': quote=c
            elif c == '(': depth+=1
            elif c == ')':
                depth-=1
                if depth==0: return s[i+1:j], j+1
        j+=1
    return None

    content = content.strip()

def render_text_segment(seg: str, fmt: str) -> str:
    seg = seg.replace('\\\n', '\u0000').replace('  \n', '\u0000').replace('\n', ' ')
    parts = seg.split('\u0000')
    out=[]
    for idx,p in enumerate(parts):
        p = p.replace('\\*','*').replace('\\_','_').replace('\\[','[').replace('\\]',']').replace('\\`','`').replace('\\#','#').replace('\\<','<').replace('\\>','>')
        if fmt in ('html','plain','ansi'):
            p = smart_text(p)
        if fmt == 'html': p = html.escape(p, quote=False)
        elif fmt == 'latex': p = tex_escape(p)
        out.append(p)
        if idx != len(parts)-1:
            out.append({'html':'<br />\n','latex':'\\\\\n','plain':'\n','markdown':'\\\n'}.get(fmt,'\n'))

def render_math_html(m: str) -> str:
    # A tiny TeX-ish presentation for common examples.
    m = html.escape(m)
    m = re.sub(r'([A-Za-z])', r'<em>\1</em>', m)
    m = re.sub(r'\^\{?([^}\s]+)\}?', lambda x: '<sup>'+x.group(1)+'</sup>', m)

    return re.sub(r'\^\{?([0-9+-=()]+)\}?', lambda x: x.group(1).translate(SUPDIG), m)

def B(t, **kw):

            i+=2; rows=[]
            while i<len(lines) and '|' in lines[i] and lines[i].strip(): rows.append(split_pipe_row(lines[i])); i+=1
            blocks.append(B('Table', headers=headers, aligns=aligns, rows=rows)); continue
        # lists
        m=re.match(r' {0,3}([-+*])\s+(.+)$', line)
        om=re.match(r' {0,3}(\d+)[.)]\s+(.+)$', line)
        if m or om:
            ordered=bool(om); start=int(om.group(1)) if om else 1; items=[]
            pat = r' {0,3}\d+[.)]\s+(.+)$' if ordered else r' {0,3}[-+*]\s+(.+)$'
            while i<len(lines):
                mm=re.match(pat, lines[i])
                if not mm: break
                item=[mm.group(1)]; i+=1
                while i<len(lines) and lines[i].startswith(('  ','    ')) and not re.match(pat, lines[i]):
                    item.append(re.sub(r'^ {2,4}', '', lines[i])); i+=1
                _, ib=parse_markdown('\n'.join(item))
                items.append(ib or [B('Para', text='')])
                while i<len(lines) and not lines[i].strip():
                    # blank ends tight list unless next item follows; keep one blank in item? pandoc tight if no blank
                    if i+1<len(lines) and re.match(pat, lines[i+1]): i+=1; break
                    else: break
            blocks.append(B('OrderedList' if ordered else 'BulletList', items=items, start=start)); continue
        # indented code
        if line.startswith('    '):
            code=[]
            while i<len(lines) and (lines[i].startswith('    ') or not lines[i].strip()):
                code.append(lines[i][4:] if lines[i].startswith('    ') else '') ; i+=1
            while code and code[-1]=='': code.pop()
            blocks.append(B('CodeBlock', text='\n'.join(code), id='', classes=[], attrs=[])); continue
        # paragraph
        para=[line]; i+=1
        while i<len(lines) and not is_block_start(i): para.append(lines[i]); i+=1
        ptxt='\n'.join(para).strip()
        im=image_only(ptxt)
        if im: blocks.append(B('Figure', alt=im[0], src=im[1], title=im[2]))
        else: blocks.append(B('Para', text=ptxt))
    return meta, blocks

def image_only(s):
    m=re.match(r'^!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^\s)]+)(?:\s+["\']([^"\']*)["\'])?\)\s*$', s.strip(), re.S)
    return (m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3) or '') if m else None

def split_pipe_row(line):
    line=line.strip()
    if line.startswith('|'): line=line[1:]
    if line.endswith('|'): line=line[:-1]
    return [c.strip() for c in re.split(r'(?<!\\)\|', line)]

class SimpleHTMLToMarkdown(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self): super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True); self.out=[]; self.stack=[]; self.href=[]; self.in_head=False
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs=dict(attrs); t=tag.lower()
        if t in ('head','script','style'): self.in_head=True; return
        if self.in_head: return
        if re.fullmatch(r'h[1-6]', t): self.out.append('\n' + '#' * int(t[1]) + ' ')
        elif t=='p': self.out.append('\n')
        elif t=='br': self.out.append('  \n')
        elif t in ('em','i'): self.out.append('*')
        elif t in ('strong','b'): self.out.append('**')
        elif t=='code': self.out.append('`')
        elif t=='pre': self.out.append('\n```\n')
        elif t=='a': self.out.append('['); self.href.append(attrs.get('href',''))
        elif t=='img': self.out.append('!['+attrs.get('alt','')+']('+attrs.get('src','')+')')
        elif t=='li': self.out.append('\n- ')
        elif t=='blockquote': self.out.append('\n> ')
        elif t=='tr': self.out.append('\n')
        elif t in ('td','th'): pass
        self.stack.append(t)
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        t=tag.lower()
        if t in ('head','script','style'): self.in_head=False; return
        if self.in_head: return
        if t in ('em','i'): self.out.append('*')
        elif t in ('strong','b'): self.out.append('**')
        elif t=='code': self.out.append('`')
        elif t=='pre': self.out.append('\n```\n')
        elif t=='a': self.out.append(']('+(self.href.pop() if self.href else '')+')')
        elif re.fullmatch(r'h[1-6]', t) or t=='p': self.out.append('\n\n')
        elif t=='blockquote': self.out.append('\n')
        if self.stack: 
            try: self.stack.remove(t)
            except ValueError: pass
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if not self.in_head: self.out.append(data)

def parse_html(text: str):
    p=SimpleHTMLToMarkdown(); p.feed(text)
    md=''.join(p.out)
    md=re.sub(r'\n{3,}', '\n\n', md).strip('\n')+'\n'
    return parse_markdown(md)

def parse_csv_text(text: str, delim=','):
    rows=list(csv.reader(StringIO(text), delimiter=delim))
    if not rows: return {}, []
    headers=rows[0]; body=rows[1:]
    return {}, [B('Table', headers=headers, aligns=['default']*len(headers), rows=body)]

def parse_json_doc(text: str):
    try: obj=json.loads(text)
    except Exception: return {}, [B('Para', text=text.strip())] if text.strip() else []
    meta=obj.get('meta',{}) if isinstance(obj,dict) else {}; blocks=[]
    # minimal pandoc json reader
    for b in obj.get('blocks',[]) if isinstance(obj,dict) else []:
        if b.get('t')=='Para': blocks.append(B('Para', text=inlines_json_to_md(b.get('c',[]))))
        elif b.get('t')=='Header': blocks.append(B('Header', level=b['c'][0], id=b['c'][1][0], classes=b['c'][1][1], text=inlines_json_to_md(b['c'][2])))
    return meta, blocks

def inlines_json_to_md(arr):
    out=[]
    for x in arr:
        t=x.get('t'); c=x.get('c')
        if t=='Str': out.append(c)
        elif t=='Space': out.append(' ')
        elif t=='SoftBreak': out.append('\n')
        elif t=='Emph': out.append('*'+inlines_json_to_md(c)+'*')
        elif t=='Strong': out.append('**'+inlines_json_to_md(c)+'**')
        elif t=='Code': out.append('`'+c[1]+'`')
    return ''.join(out)

# ---------- writers ----------
def write_blocks(blocks, fmt: str, meta=None, opts=None) -> str:
    meta=meta or {}; opts=opts or {}
    if fmt in ('html','html5','html4','chunkedhtml','revealjs','s5','slidy','slideous','dzslides'):
        body=write_html(blocks, opts)
        if opts.get('standalone'):
            title = get_title(meta, opts)
            header=''
            if meta.get('title'):
                header='<header id="title-block-header">\n<h1 class="title">'+render_inlines(str(meta.get('title')),'html')+'</h1>\n</header>\n'
            toc = make_toc(blocks) if opts.get('toc') else ''
            return HTML_TEMPLATE.format(title=html.escape(title), header=header, toc=toc, body=body)
        return body
    if fmt in ('plain','ansi'): return write_plain(blocks)
    if fmt in ('markdown','commonmark','commonmark_x','gfm','markdown_github','markdown_strict','markdown_mmd','markdown_phpextra'): return write_markdown(blocks)
    if fmt in ('latex','beamer','context'): return write_latex(blocks, meta, opts)
    if fmt=='json': return write_json(blocks, meta)
    if fmt=='native': return write_native(blocks)
    if fmt=='rst': return write_rst(blocks)
    if fmt=='man': return write_man(blocks)
    if fmt in ('docbook','docbook4','docbook5','xml','opendocument','tei'): return write_xmlish(blocks)
    if fmt in ('csv','tsv'): return write_csv(blocks, '\t' if fmt=='tsv' else ',')
    # unsupported rich formats: produce markdown/plain textual content rather than failing
    return write_markdown(blocks) if fmt in OUTPUT_FORMATS else write_html(blocks, opts)

def get_title(meta, opts):
    if 'title' in meta: return str(meta['title'])
    files=opts.get('files') or []
    if files: return os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(files[0]))[0]
    return ''

def make_toc(blocks):
    heads=[b for b in blocks if b['t']=='Header']
    if not heads: return ''
    out=['<nav id="TOC" role="doc-toc">','<ul>']
    for h in heads: out.append(f'<li><a href="#{h["id"]}">{render_inlines(h["text"],"html")}</a></li>')
    out += ['</ul>','</nav>']
    return '\n'.join(out)+'\n'

def write_html(blocks, opts=None):
    out=[]
    for b in blocks:
        t=b['t']
        if t=='Header': out.append(f'<h{b["level"]} id="{html.escape(b.get("id") or slugify(render_inlines(b["text"],"plain")), quote=True)}">{render_inlines(b["text"],"html")}</h{b["level"]}>')
        elif t=='Para': out.append('<p>'+render_inlines(b['text'],'html')+'</p>')
        elif t=='Plain': out.append(render_inlines(b['text'],'html'))
        elif t=='CodeBlock':
            cls=''
            if b.get('classes'): cls=' class="'+' '.join('language-'+html.escape(c,quote=True) for c in b['classes'])+'"'
            out.append(f'<pre><code{cls}>'+html.escape(b.get('text',''))+'</code></pre>')
        elif t=='HorizontalRule': out.append('<hr />')
        elif t=='BlockQuote': out.append('<blockquote>\n'+write_html(b['blocks']).rstrip('\n')+'\n</blockquote>')
        elif t=='BulletList':
            out.append('<ul>')
            for item in b['items']: out.append('<li>'+write_item_html(item)+'</li>')
            out.append('</ul>')
        elif t=='OrderedList':
            attr='' if b.get('start',1)==1 else f' start="{b.get("start")}"'
            out.append(f'<ol type="1"{attr}>')
            for item in b['items']: out.append('<li>'+write_item_html(item)+'</li>')
            out.append('</ol>')
        elif t=='Table': out.append(write_table_html(b))
        elif t=='RawBlock': out.append(b.get('text',''))
        elif t=='Figure':
            altplain=render_inlines(b['alt'],'plain')
            attrs=f'src="{html.escape(b["src"],quote=True)}"'
            if b.get('title'): attrs += f' title="{html.escape(b["title"],quote=True)}"'
            attrs += f' alt="{html.escape(altplain,quote=True)}"'
            out.append('<figure>\n<img '+attrs+' />\n<figcaption aria-hidden="true">'+render_inlines(b['alt'],'html')+'</figcaption>\n</figure>')
    return '\n'.join(out)+'\n'

def write_item_html(item):
    if len(item)==1 and item[0]['t']=='Para': return render_inlines(item[0]['text'],'html')
    return '\n'+write_html(item).rstrip('\n')+'\n'

def write_table_html(b):
    aligns=b.get('aligns') or []
    def style(i, head=False):
        al=aligns[i] if i<len(aligns) else 'default'
        return ' style="text-align: right;"' if al=='right' else ' style="text-align: center;"' if al=='center' else ' style="text-align: left;"' if al=='left' and not head else ''
    out=['<table>','<thead>','<tr>']
    for i,h in enumerate(b.get('headers',[])): out.append(f'<th{style(i, True)}>{render_inlines(h,"html")}</th>')
    out += ['</tr>','</thead>','<tbody>']
    for row in b.get('rows',[]):
        out.append('<tr>')
        for i,c in enumerate(row): out.append(f'<td{style(i)}>{render_inlines(c,"html")}</td>')
        out.append('</tr>')
    out += ['</tbody>','</table>']
    return '\n'.join(out)

def write_plain(blocks):
    parts=[]
    for b in blocks:
        t=b['t']
        if t=='Header': parts.append(render_inlines(b['text'],'plain'))
        elif t=='Para': parts.append(render_inlines(b['text'],'plain'))
        elif t=='CodeBlock': parts.append(textwrap.indent(b.get('text',''),'    '))
        elif t=='HorizontalRule': parts.append('-'*72)
        elif t=='BlockQuote': parts.append(textwrap.indent(write_plain(b['blocks']).strip(),'  '))
        elif t=='BulletList':
            parts.append('\n'.join('- '+write_plain(item).strip().replace('\n','\n  ') for item in b['items']))
        elif t=='OrderedList':
            parts.append('\n'.join(f'{i+b.get("start",1)}.  '+write_plain(item).strip().replace('\n','\n    ') for i,item in enumerate(b['items'])))
        elif t=='Table': parts.append(write_table_markdown(b))
        elif t=='RawBlock': parts.append(strip_tags(b.get('text','')))
        elif t=='Figure': parts.append('['+render_inlines(b['alt'],'plain')+']')
    return '\n\n'.join(p for p in parts if p!='')+'\n'

def write_markdown(blocks):
    parts=[]
    for b in blocks:
        t=b['t']
        if t=='Header': parts.append('#'*b['level']+' '+render_inlines(b['text'],'markdown'))
        elif t=='Para': parts.append(render_inlines(b['text'],'markdown'))
        elif t=='CodeBlock':
            if b.get('classes') or b.get('id') or '```' in b.get('text',''):
                info=' '.join(b.get('classes') or [])
                parts.append('```'+info+'\n'+b.get('text','')+'\n```')
            else: parts.append(textwrap.indent(b.get('text',''),'    '))
        elif t=='HorizontalRule': parts.append('-'*72)
        elif t=='BlockQuote': parts.append('\n'.join('> '+ln if ln else '>' for ln in write_markdown(b['blocks']).strip().split('\n')))
        elif t=='BulletList': parts.append('\n'.join('- '+write_markdown(item).strip().replace('\n','\n  ') for item in b['items']))
        elif t=='OrderedList': parts.append('\n'.join(f'{i+b.get("start",1)}.  '+write_markdown(item).strip().replace('\n','\n    ') for i,item in enumerate(b['items'])))
        elif t=='Table': parts.append(write_table_markdown(b))
        elif t=='RawBlock': parts.append(b.get('text',''))
        elif t=='Figure': parts.append(f'![{b["alt"]}]({b["src"]}'+(f' "{b["title"]}"' if b.get('title') else '')+')')
    return '\n\n'.join(parts)+'\n'

def write_table_markdown(b):
    rows=[b.get('headers',[])] + b.get('rows',[])
    n=max((len(r) for r in rows), default=0)
    widths=[3]*n
    for r in rows:
        for i,c in enumerate(r): widths[i]=max(widths[i], len(render_inlines(c,'plain')))
    def fmtrow(r):
        return '  ' + ' '.join((render_inlines(r[i],'markdown') if i<len(r) else '').ljust(widths[i]) for i in range(n)).rstrip() if n else ''
    sep='  '+' '.join('-'*widths[i] for i in range(n)).rstrip()
    out=[fmtrow(b.get('headers',[])), sep]
    out += [fmtrow(r) for r in b.get('rows',[])]
    return '\n'.join(out)

def write_latex(blocks, meta=None, opts=None):
    parts=[]
    for b in blocks:
        t=b['t']
        if t=='Header':
            cmds=['section','subsection','subsubsection','paragraph','subparagraph','subparagraph']; parts.append('\\'+cmds[min(b['level'],6)-1]+'{'+render_inlines(b['text'],'latex')+'}\\label{'+(b.get('id') or slugify(b['text']))+'}')
        elif t=='Para': parts.append(render_inlines(b['text'],'latex'))
        elif t=='CodeBlock': parts.append('\\begin{verbatim}\n'+b.get('text','')+'\n\\end{verbatim}')
        elif t=='HorizontalRule': parts.append(r'\begin{center}\rule{0.5\linewidth}{0.5pt}\end{center}')
        elif t=='BlockQuote': parts.append('\\begin{quote}\n'+write_latex(b['blocks']).strip()+'\n\\end{quote}')
        elif t=='BulletList':
            s=['\\begin{itemize}',r'\tightlist']
            for item in b['items']: s.append('\\item\n  '+write_latex(item).strip().replace('\n','\n  '))
            s.append('\\end{itemize}'); parts.append('\n'.join(s))
        elif t=='OrderedList':
            s=['\\begin{enumerate}',r'\def\labelenumi{\arabic{enumi}.}',r'\tightlist']
            for item in b['items']: s.append('\\item\n  '+write_latex(item).strip().replace('\n','\n  '))
            s.append('\\end{enumerate}'); parts.append('\n'.join(s))
        elif t=='Table': parts.append(write_table_latex(b))
        elif t=='RawBlock': parts.append(strip_tags(b.get('text','')))
        elif t=='Figure':
            parts.append('\\begin{figure}\n\\centering\n\\pandocbounded{\\includegraphics[keepaspectratio,alt={'+tex_escape(render_inlines(b['alt'],'plain'))+'}]{'+tex_escape(b['src'])+'}}\n\\caption{'+render_inlines(b['alt'],'latex')+'}\n\\end{figure}')
    body='\n\n'.join(parts)+'\n'
    if opts and opts.get('standalone'):
        title = meta.get('title','') if meta else ''
        return '\\documentclass{article}\n\\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}\n\\usepackage{hyperref}\n\\begin{document}\n' + (('\\title{'+tex_escape(str(title))+'}\n\\maketitle\n') if title else '') + body + '\\end{document}\n'
    return body

def write_table_latex(b):
    n=len(b.get('headers',[])); spec=''.join('r' if a=='right' else 'c' if a=='center' else 'l' for a in (b.get('aligns') or ['l']*n))
    out=['\\begin{longtable}[]{@{}'+spec+'@{}}', r'\toprule\noalign{}']
    out.append(' & '.join(render_inlines(x,'latex') for x in b.get('headers',[])) + r' \\')
    out += [r'\midrule\noalign{}', r'\endhead', r'\bottomrule\noalign{}', r'\endlastfoot']
    for row in b.get('rows',[]): out.append(' & '.join(render_inlines(x,'latex') for x in row) + r' \\')
    out.append('\\end{longtable}')
    return '\n'.join(out)

def inline_json_from_text(s):
    # Basic tokenization matching Pandoc JSON shape for plain words/spaces and common inline elements.
    plain=render_inlines(s,'plain')
    arr=[]
    parts=re.split(r'(\s+)', plain)
    for p in parts:
        if p=='': continue
        if p.isspace(): arr.append({'t':'Space'})
        else: arr.append({'t':'Str','c':p})
    return arr

def block_json(b):
    t=b['t']
    if t=='Header': return {'t':'Header','c':[b['level'],[b.get('id',''),b.get('classes',[]),[]],inline_json_from_text(b['text'])]}
    if t=='Para': return {'t':'Para','c':inline_json_from_text(b['text'])}
    if t=='CodeBlock': return {'t':'CodeBlock','c':[[b.get('id',''),b.get('classes',[]),b.get('attrs',[])],b.get('text','')]}
    if t=='HorizontalRule': return {'t':'HorizontalRule'}
    if t=='BlockQuote': return {'t':'BlockQuote','c':[block_json(x) for x in b['blocks']]}
    if t=='BulletList': return {'t':'BulletList','c':[[block_json(x) for x in item] for item in b['items']]}
    if t=='OrderedList': return {'t':'OrderedList','c':[[b.get('start',1),{'t':'Decimal'},{'t':'Period'}],[[block_json(x) for x in item] for item in b['items']]]}
    if t=='Table': return {'t':'Table','c':str(b)}
    if t=='RawBlock': return {'t':'RawBlock','c':[b.get('format','html'),b.get('text','')]}
    return {'t':'Para','c':[]}

def write_json(blocks, meta=None):
    return json.dumps({'pandoc-api-version':[1,23,1,1],'meta':{},'blocks':[block_json(b) for b in blocks]}, separators=(',',':'))+'\n'

def write_native(blocks):
    def inl(s): return '[ ' + ' , '.join(('Space' if p.isspace() else 'Str '+json.dumps(p)) for p in re.split(r'(\s+)', render_inlines(s,'plain')) if p) + ' ]'
    out=[]
    for b in blocks:
        if b['t']=='Header': out.append(f'Header {b["level"]} ( {json.dumps(b.get("id",""))} , [] , [] ) '+inl(b['text']))
        elif b['t']=='Para': out.append('Para '+inl(b['text']))
        elif b['t']=='CodeBlock': out.append('CodeBlock ( "" , [] , [] ) '+json.dumps(b.get('text','')))
        elif b['t']=='HorizontalRule': out.append('HorizontalRule')
        elif b['t']=='BulletList': out.append('BulletList [ '+', '.join('[ Plain '+inl(write_plain(it).strip())+' ]' for it in b['items'])+' ]')
        else: out.append(b['t'])
    return '[ ' + '\n, '.join(out) + '\n]\n'

def write_rst(blocks):
    parts=[]
    for b in blocks:
        if b['t']=='Header':
            txt=render_inlines(b['text'],'plain'); ch='=' if b['level']==1 else '-' if b['level']==2 else '~'; parts.append(txt+'\n'+ch*len(txt))
        elif b['t']=='Para': parts.append(render_inlines(b['text'],'markdown').replace('`','``'))
        elif b['t']=='BulletList': parts.append('\n'.join('- '+write_rst(it).strip() for it in b['items']))
        elif b['t']=='OrderedList': parts.append('\n'.join(f'{i+1}. '+write_rst(it).strip() for i,it in enumerate(b['items'])))
        elif b['t']=='CodeBlock': parts.append('::\n\n'+textwrap.indent(b.get('text',''),'   '))
        elif b['t']=='HorizontalRule': parts.append('-'*14)
        elif b['t']=='BlockQuote': parts.append('..\n\n'+textwrap.indent(write_rst(b['blocks']).strip(),'   '))
        elif b['t']=='Table': parts.append(write_table_markdown(b).replace('---','='))
    return '\n\n'.join(parts)+'\n'

def write_man(blocks):
    parts=[]
    for b in blocks:
        if b['t']=='Header': parts.append('.SH '+render_inlines(b['text'],'plain'))
        elif b['t']=='Para': parts.append(render_inlines(b['text'],'plain'))
        elif b['t']=='BulletList': parts.extend('.IP \\(bu 2\n'+write_man(it).strip() for it in b['items'])
        elif b['t']=='OrderedList': parts.extend(f'.IP "{i+1}." 3\n'+write_man(it).strip() for i,it in enumerate(b['items']))
        elif b['t']=='CodeBlock': parts.append('.IP\n.EX\n'+b.get('text','')+'\n.EE')
        elif b['t']=='HorizontalRule': parts.append('.PP\n   *   *   *   *   *')
        elif b['t']=='BlockQuote': parts.append('.RS\n.PP\n'+write_man(b['blocks']).strip()+'\n.RE')
    return '\n'.join(parts)+'\n'

def write_xmlish(blocks):
    return '<document>\n' + ''.join('<para>'+html.escape(render_inlines(write_plain([b]).strip(),'plain'))+'</para>\n' for b in blocks) + '</document>\n'

def write_csv(blocks, delim=','):
    for b in blocks:
        if b['t']=='Table':
            sio=StringIO(); w=csv.writer(sio, delimiter=delim, lineterminator='\n')
            w.writerow(b.get('headers',[])); w.writerows(b.get('rows',[])); return sio.getvalue()
    return ''

def strip_tags(s): return re.sub(r'<[^>]*>', '', s)

# ---------- command-line ----------
class Opts(dict):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(from_fmt=None, to_fmt=None, output=None, standalone=False, metadata={}, variables={}, files=[], toc=False, dump_args=False, ignore_args=False, quiet=False)

def parse_args(argv):
